summary: Full resolution of findings F1-F3 from DRIVE_01_F01_REVIEW.md across resource lifecycle ownership and non-blocking caller close (F1), mandatory 9-field identity schema and fail-closed stop/mount-cleanup verification (F2), and PowerShell 5.1 CJK / Unicode source encoding compatibility (F3). Verified by automated test suites (109 Maven, 72 PowerShell, 3 repro detectors) and fresh-root browser walkthrough exit 0.

F1_resourceLifecycleAndStalledClose.finding: IO deadlines do not own late resources or bound request cleanup. Late-completing channel opens leak file descriptors after caller timeout; channel close blocks request thread when native read is blocked in WinFsp kernel.
F1_resourceLifecycleAndStalledClose.resolution: Implemented explicit ownership handshake (PENDING, CALLER_ACQUIRED, TIMED_OUT) in DriveIoExecutor.executeOpen and automatic late AutoCloseable disposal in executeWithTimeout. Non-blocking DriveSeekableByteChannel.close marks closed immediately while actualOutstandingWorkers accounts for in-flight kernel operation until physical OS exit.
F1_resourceLifecycleAndStalledClose.tests: DriveLateOpenLifecycleTest (5/5 PASS), DriveCleanupDeadlineTest (3/3 PASS), reviewer repro DRIVE_F01_late_open.java (lateOpenChannelStillOpen=false actualWorkers=0), reviewer repro DRIVE_F01_channel_close.java (callerStillBlockedInClose=false ioWorkers=1)

F2_mandatoryProcessIdentity.finding: stop_drive.ps1 extracted sessionId, mountPoint, remoteTarget, arguments, and status but did not require them. Missing processName defaulted to rclone. Reviewer repro showed termination signaled with incomplete identity fields.
F2_mandatoryProcessIdentity.resolution: Mandated all 9 state schema fields (pid, processName, executablePath, startTime, sessionId, mountPoint, remoteTarget, arguments, status). Missing any field fails closed (Status=VERIFICATION_FAILED), preserves state file on disk, and never signals process. Applied identical strict verification to mount launch-failure cleanup.
F2_mandatoryProcessIdentity.tests: test_drive_security_seams.ps1 (30/30 PASS, including TC-F2-01 to TC-F2-10), reviewer repro DRIVE_F01_stop_missing_identity.ps1 (terminationRequestedWithMissingIdentityFields=False across PS 5.1 and PS 7)

F3_powerShell51Encoding.finding: PowerShell 5.1 failed to parse test_drive_toolkit_comprehensive.ps1 at line 144 before executing any tests due to ANSI code page decoding of raw UTF-8 CJK literals.
F3_powerShell51Encoding.resolution: Replaced embedded multibyte CJK and Vietnamese string literals with UTF-8 byte array construction ([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([byte[]]@(...))) and added UTF-8 BOM, ensuring clean -File execution on both Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7.
F3_powerShell51Encoding.tests: test_drive_toolkit_comprehensive.ps1 (28/28 PASS on powershell.exe 5.1 and pwsh 7)

G2_MOUNTED_DRIVE.reason: Requires user interactive OAuth authentication via rclone config (drive.readonly), WinFsp driver installation, and selection of remote folder.
G2_MOUNTED_DRIVE.actionRequiredFromUser: Follow setup guide in docs/runbooks/GOOGLE_DRIVE_WINDOWS_RUNBOOK.md and run scripts/drive/mount_drive.ps1 with -Execute.

G3_BROWSER_DRIVE.reason: Requires an active live Google Drive mount (depends on G2).
G3_BROWSER_DRIVE.actionRequiredFromUser: Once G2 is established, execute walkthrough against live mount as documented in docs/runbooks/DRIVE_PERFORMANCE_PLAN.md.
